summary: Verified new money+frequency subtitle line in CoinQuest child dashboard 'My jobs' card for blank_wallet_child (Grade 3, no classroom). Seeded 3 payday jobs with different frequencies (weekly@₹100, three_week@₹30, daily@₹0-unpriced). All three requested formats rendered exactly per spec: 'Walk the dog / ₹100 for once a week' (🐕), 'Water the plants / ₹30 for three times a week' (🌱), 'Organize the entire bookshelf and dust it / Every day' (no ₹0 fallback confirmed). Verified See-all button navigates to /my-jobs. No raw enum labels (weekly, three_week, twice_week, as_needed) leaked to UI. Overflow check: long activity name has truncate class applied, no clipping issue at 1920x1080 and 390x844 viewports. Regression pass: classmate_g1 and classmate_g3 (both with classrooms) correctly show My classroom leaderboard (no My jobs card); classmate_g4_qa Grade 4 dashboard unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx JOB_FREQUENCIES and MyJobsPage.jsx FREQUENCIES are duplicated string maps — consider extracting to a shared util (e.g., /app/frontend/src/utils/jobFrequencies.js) to avoid future drift.
Dashboard.jsx is 1030 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; could be split into smaller components (JobsCard, ClassroomCard, etc.).
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created 3 payday jobs on blank_wallet_child via POST /api/child/jobs, set payment_amount + status via direct MongoDB write on my_jobs collection, then fully cleaned up (DELETE via API for pending job + direct mongo delete_many for approved-status jobs). No residual test data.
